input.command:
python3 -c '
# Triangulate Chair 1 across obs 88, 89, 90:
import cv2, numpy as np

img90 = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0090.png")
mask = (img90[:,:,2] > 90) & (img90[:,:,2] < 160) & (img90[:,:,1] > 40) & (img90[:,:,1] < 80) & (img90[:,:,0] < 40)
ys, xs = np.where(mask[:, 140:260])
xs += 140
print(f"Chair 1 in obs 90: x=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], width={xs.max()-xs.min()+1}, bottom_y={ys.max()}, center_x={xs.mean():.1f}")

ws = np.array([71.0, 83.0, float(xs.max()-xs.min()+1)])
# Step is 0.5 along heading 210 deg
# In heading 210: step along optical axis is Delta Z = 0.5 m
d_steps = np.array([0.0, 0.5, 1.0])
inv_w = 1.0 / ws
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(d_steps, inv_w, 1)
# inv_w = 0 at distance to chair:
d88 = -intercept / slope
print(f"Distance to chair 1 from obs 88: {d88:.4f} m, from obs 90: {d88 - 1.0:.4f} m")

# Pose at obs 90:
# obs 89 was (-1.6348, 4.2312), moved 0.5 along 210 deg:
# X = -1.6348 - 0.2500 = -1.8848
# Y = 4.2312 - 0.4330 = 3.7982
d90 = d88 - 1.0
theta_rad = np.deg2rad(210.0)
Xc90 = (xs.mean() - 255.5) / 256.0 * d90
X_w = -1.8848 + d90 * np.sin(theta_rad) + Xc90 * np.cos(theta_rad)
Y_w = 3.7982 + d90 * np.cos(theta_rad) - Xc90 * np.sin(theta_rad)
print(f"Chair 1 refined world position: X = {X_w:.4f}, Y = {Y_w:.4f}")
'
